item.title: Hot wax - Candle Tetris!
item.author: invalid@example.com (Shiki)
item.dc:creator: Shiki
item.content:encoded: Had this little game on my rader for over a year now and really enjoyed the demo. It's finally out! It's a falling block puzzle game where every block also acts as a candle with a wick at both ends. Every so often you get a flame "block" that can ignite blocks and melt them slowly (in the main mode at least) and trigger long satisfying combos from the flame jumping from one candle to the next, or multiple ones if you place them right!.
